text:
Alex Nguyen: FYI PR #6789 (repo: inference) is blocked on architecture review — RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/424-kv-shard-placement. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/6789. Need arch signoff before we can merge for the Thursday release.
Priya Shah: Quick q — what specifically needs approval? Behavioral change or just node placement/config?
Alex Nguyen: It's changing KV routing + node affinity heuristics. Main risk: uneven hot-keying after shard relocation. I ran a gate perf run; adding numbers below.
Eve Park: From what I recall that's sensitive. Can you paste p50/p95 token latencies + tail CPU for a 1h sim? Also include failure modes (what happens if placement fails).
Alex Nguyen: Sure — small paste:
```
baseline p50: 23ms
baseline p95: 72ms
with-shard-placement p50: 25ms
with-shard-placement p95: 85ms
cpu tail (99): baseline 68% -> with change 74%
```
Alex Nguyen: Failure mode: if placement step errors, we fall back to round-robin placement (config flag `--fallback=rr`) and emit an alert `kv-placement/fallback` to SRE; degrade throughput gracefully.
Dan O'Connor: Suggest adding a feature flag and an explicit canary rollout plan in the PR. Also add a small integration test that simulates a placement error path.
CI-Bot: CI: all checks passing except flaky-integration (retrigger recommended) :white_check_mark:
Sam Rivera: What's the canary percentage and rollback trigger?
Alex Nguyen: Canary plan: 10% traffic for 6 hours, monitor error rate and p95. Rollback if error rate > 0.5% or p95 regression >20%.
Eve Park: Thanks — that helps. Two asks before I can approve: 1) add the perf table above to the PR description, 2) add a one-paragraph failure-mode section and the feature flag docs. If you do that I can review and give LGTM tomorrow morning.
Priya Shah: We really need this in by Thu to hit the release. Alex can you update before EOD today?
Alex Nguyen: Yep — I'll update the PR with perf table, failure doc, feature flag, and the integration test. Will ping here when done.
CI-Bot: CI: retriggered flaky-integration — build queued :gear:
Eve Park: :eyes: will review once PR updated. Thanks.
Priya Shah: :thumbsup:
